# Webster Building

> Webster Building is a licensed carpentry and building business based in Shellharbour, NSW, Australia, run by Lachy Webster (Cert III Carpentry, AHHA-certified, Licence No. 386548C). It services Shellharbour, Kiama, Albion Park, Albion Park Rail, Oak Flats, Warilla, Barrack Heights, Dapto, Wollongong, Bulli, Thirroul, Gerringong, Berry and the wider Illawarra region of New South Wales.

Core services, in priority order: fireplace installation, timber flooring installation, decks and pergolas, fencing, and residential carpentry and repairs. Free, no-obligation quotes. NSW Fair Trading statutory warranty applies (6 years for major structural defects, 2 years for general building work).

## Services

- [Fireplace Installations](https://websterbuilding.com.au/services/fireplaces-mantels/): AHHA-certified fireplace and feature wall installation, compliant with AS/NZS 2918.
- [Flooring Installation](https://websterbuilding.com.au/services/flooring/): Hybrid, laminate, vinyl, timber and herringbone flooring installation.
- [Decks & Pergolas](https://websterbuilding.com.au/services/decks-pergolas/): Custom timber decks, pergolas and outdoor living areas, including sloping and coastal blocks.
- [Fencing Installation](https://websterbuilding.com.au/services/fencing/): Timber and Colorbond boundary fencing, gates and repairs.
- [Residential Carpentry & Repairs](https://websterbuilding.com.au/services/carpentry/): Structural framing, internal fix-outs, cladding repairs and general carpentry, no job too small.
